title: “Your Country” Questions
author: 652175ce9cd133611505f671
chapter_outcomes: Write structured responses, using a range of appropriate language for a variety of purposes
Communicate information, ideas and opinions clearly and accurately
Construct cohesive and organised responses, linking ideas and arguments
Develop the skills to write in accurate English in a clear, coherent and structured way, including essays
Learn to write shorter responses for a variety of purposes including: explanation, description, summary, analysis, evaluation and persuasion
Learn to use a range of vocabulary, appropriate spelling, grammar and punctuation, and use of register, to communicate information, ideas and opinions appropriate to the task
The register used in the response should demonstrate the type of written communication skills required for entering employment or further study
